summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repo (uncommitted). Changes: rich/progress.py (new TimeElapsedColumn, Task.finished_time field, finished property based on finished_time, capture in update and advance inside the lock, clearing in _reset and reset); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with lazy imports); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added entry); tests/test_progress.py (new test_time_elapsed_column, import, TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns with regenerated expected output); tests/test_palette.py (test_rich_cast). Tests were NOT run, per instructions. The test_columns expected output was derived by hand-tracing clock reads, and the regex checks confirm the edits, but the output is unverified until test_columns is run. Other existing tests (test_render, test_finished, test_time_remaining_column, test_track) were traced and expected to be unchanged, also unverified.
